_doc: 0.26.9 (#468, ADR-0269-assist): the PUBLIC halves of the official Agent J remote-assist key. Shipped inside the signed host package and never fetched from the network; a list so a key can be rotated (each entry: id, x25519 = Noise static public key, ed25519 = signing public key, both b64url 32 bytes, not_after = unix seconds). An entry whose keys are null is never usable.
